aspect: EXAMPLE - the Chinese route through Mexico
description: Border Patrol encountered 330 mainland Chinese migrants between ports of entry in FY2021; in 2023 it was 24,050. Many flew to Ecuador, which required no visa, then to Tijuana, paying around $400 for a drive to a gap in the fence; others paid $7,000-10,000 for routes through the Darién Gap. Crossings fell to 1,326 by September 2024.
energy_note: From Guangdong to Tijuana, via Quito.

aspect: THE HONEST GAP - Chinese state media largely did not cover it
description: The brief asked for Chinese agency sources. Searching for Xinhua, CGTN or Global Times coverage of Chinese migrants at the US-Mexico border surfaced none; the reporting is Western and Hong Kong outlets. The absence is recorded rather than papered over with a substitute.
energy_note: The Chinese agencies did not report it.

aspect: Mexico as the enforcer of someone else's border
description: Mexican enforcement against third-country nationals is shaped by US policy and trade leverage, so Mexico polices a border that is not its own, against people who did not intend to stay.
energy_note: Policing a frontier belonging to another country.
